name: tripartite motif containing 11

function.text: TRIM11 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM11. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and protein autoubiquitination.
